+    def search(chosen, requirements, graph):
+        nonlocal best, best_vector
+        pending = [name for name in requirements if name not in chosen]
+        if not pending:
+            if not acyclic(graph, chosen):
+                return
+            vector = tuple(chosen.get(name, -1) for name in names)
+            if best_vector is None or (vector > best_vector if preference == "maximum"
+                                       else vector < best_vector):
+                best, best_vector = dict(chosen), vector
+            return
+
+        name = min(pending)
+        low, high = requirements[name]
+        rows = [row for row in packages[name]
+                if low <= row["version"] <= high
+                and row["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                and (name not in pins or row["version"] == pins[name])]
+        for row in rows:
+            version = row["version"]
+            deps = [dep for dep in row.get("deps", [])
+                    if not dep.get("feature") or dep["feature"] in features]
+            next_requirements = dict(requirements)
+            next_graph = {key: list(value) for key, value in graph.items()}
+            next_graph[name] = []
+            valid = True
+            for dep in deps:
+                other = dep["name"]
+                next_graph[name].append(other)
+                lo, hi = dep["min"], dep["max"]
+                if other in next_requirements:
+                    old_lo, old_hi = next_requirements[other]
+                    lo, hi = max(lo, old_lo), min(hi, old_hi)
+                if lo > hi:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+                next_requirements[other] = (lo, hi)
+                if other in chosen and not lo <= chosen[other] <= hi:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+            if valid:
+                next_chosen = dict(chosen)
+                next_chosen[name] = version
+                search(next_chosen, next_requirements, next_graph)
+
+    initial = {name: tuple(bounds) for name, bounds in data["roots"].items()}
+    search({}, initial, {})
+    return {"versions": best} if best is not None else {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+

+def _build_dependency(name_order, preference):
+    return lambda data: _dependency_solver(data, name_order, preference)
